name: Crownkeep
description:
About This Game

Crownkeep is a roguelike deckbuilder of tactics and deduction. Fight your way through dungeons with grid-based tactical combat. Build up your deck, forge powerful combos, and defy the madness that devoured the realm.

Uncover the Dungeon - Tile by Tile

Use threat markers as clues to predict where monsters lurk before revealing them. Choose your steps carefully to outsmart your enemies and avoid the most dangerous threats.

Fight Tactical Battles - Card by Card

Maneuver your way through tactical battles where monster positioning matters. With one card in your hand, plot its use or send it back to the bottom of your deck.

Craft Powerful Combos

Forge a deck and exploit game-warping synergies with 100s of cards and items. The danger will scale rapidly as you descend deeper into the dungeon - can you build a deck that will survive the challenge?

Choose from 3 unique classes, all with their own cards, items and mechanics. Will you sneak past monsters as the Rogue, engulf the dungeon in an inferno as the Mage, or just slice your enemies into little pieces as the Warrior?

Endlessly Replayable

No two runs are ever the same. Discover hidden card synergies and experiment with strange builds to unlock new cards, items, and challenges as you triumph in the dungeon. 

As you master the game, increase the corruption to face the truth, or die trying.
short_desc: Crownkeep is a roguelike deckbuilder that mixes minesweeper with dungeon crawling. Fight your way through deadly grid-based dungeons with one card in your hand. Build up your deck, forge powerful combos, and defy the madness that devoured the realm.
